nodes.text:
You've come DOWN here. On purpose.

I want you to know that everyone up the shelf thinks that is remarkable and everyone down here thinks it is a bit stupid.

choices.label: Why are you down here, then?

nodes.text:
Both, obviously. That is what remarkable means most of the time.

Go on. I'm not going to be the one who talks you out of it - nobody down here has that much standing.

Born on the shelf. My family were Tidewatch, before.

I say 'before' and you will notice I have not said before WHAT. Nobody here does. It is not superstition, it is just that the sentence does not have a good ending.

choices.label: Which is it - remarkable or stupid?
